title: Laya: requests, question types, confidence
description: Jev decision-log observability: decisions, types, self-estimated confidence and abstentions.

panels.title: Jev log source up
panels.description: Collector read status for the Jev decision log. 1 means readable on last collection; 0 means source unavailable.

panels.title: Jev state source up
panels.description: Persistent cursor/state health; 0 means state was unreadable or invalid.

panels.title: Decision freshness (seconds)
panels.description: Seconds since each backend’s newest logged decision. The Jev log only grows when agents ask questions, so idle periods are normal; yellow indicates age, not an outage. No series means no known decision timestamp; this is not request latency.

panels.title: Decisions in selected range by backend
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected range, grouped by backend. Values are decisions recorded in the log, not HTTP requests.

panels.title: About this dashboard
panels.description: Laya request telemetry begins at the cutover after the Laya image switch; the earlier window is a gap. Question and answer text is not stored.

options.content:
### Laya request telemetry
Data starts at the cutover after the Laya image switch. The earlier window is a gap: about 1,082 requests after 2026-11-20 08:19 -03 and the period before it are not recorded; 1,542 older spans were never ingested.

Question and answer text is not stored.

### Jev decisions
Confidence is the model's own estimate, **not measured accuracy**.

panels.title: Decisions per hour by backend
panels.description: Decision-log rate per hour by backend, using a 15-minute window to cover 5-minute backfilled samples.

panels.title: Decisions per hour by type and backend
panels.description: Decision-log rate per hour grouped by backend and question type, using 15-minute rate windows.

panels.title: Decisions per hour by caller
panels.description: Decision-log rate per hour by allowlisted caller and backend; callers outside the bounded allowlist are grouped as other.

panels.title: Lifetime decision totals by caller
panels.description: Cumulative decision counters by backend and caller since the current log generation; not limited to the selected time range.

panels.title: Laya confidence quantiles by type (p50 / p90)
panels.description: Selected-range top-confidence p50 and p90 by Laya question type, with a sample-count column. Types without observations show n/a; quantiles are interpolated from fixed buckets and confidence is a self-estimate, not accuracy.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="choice"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="choice"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="choice"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="choice"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="noul"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="noul"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="noul"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="noul"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="score"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="score"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket{backend="laya",type="score"}[$__range]))) and on(type) (sum by (type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count{backend="laya",type="score"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Average confidence by type and backend
panels.description: Mean observed top confidence by backend and type over the selected range, shown only with at least 20 samples. Self-estimate, not accuracy.

targets.expr: (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_sum[$__range])) / sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count[$__range]))) and on (backend,type) (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count[$__range])) >= 20)

panels.title: Confidence bucket distribution (selected range)
panels.description: Non-cumulative confidence observations by backend, type and fixed bucket over the selected range. This is a histogram count, not probability density or accuracy.

panels.title: Decision share by type: laya
panels.description: Share of recorded laya decisions by type over the selected range. Typesafe may have no data until it records decisions. Shares add up to 100% when data is present; zero-volume backend yields no series. No data is shown when the selected range has no recorded decisions.

targets.expr: sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="laya"}[$__range])) / on (backend) group_left() sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="laya"}[$__range])) and on (backend) (sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="laya"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Abstention rate by backend and type
panels.description: Fallback-needed decisions divided by answered decisions over the selected range; displayed only at 20+ answered samples. This is model abstention/deferral to caller, not an error or proof the caller invoked fallback.

targets.expr: (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_fallback_needed_total[$__range])) / sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range]))) and on (backend,type) (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range])) >= 20)

panels.title: Error outcome rate by backend
panels.description: Error-outcome decisions divided by all decisions over the selected range; no observations yield n/a. Zero-fills an absent error counter only when that backend has decisions in the selected range; a backend with no decisions remains n/a.

targets.expr: (((sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="error"}[$__range]))) or on (backend) (0 * sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total[$__range]))) ) / sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total[$__range]))) and on (backend) (sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Answered share by backend
panels.description: Answered decisions divided by all logged outcomes over selected range; answered share = 1 - abstention-and-error share. No observations yields no series.

targets.expr: (sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range])) / sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total[$__range]))) and on (backend) (sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Abstention rate comparison by backend and type
panels.description: Selected-range fallback-needed share among answered decisions. This is model abstention/deferral, not an error or confirmed downstream fallback.

targets.expr: (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_fallback_needed_total[$__range])) / sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range]))) and on (backend,type) (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: p50 confidence comparison by backend and type
panels.description: p50 top-confidence by backend/type over selected range, shown only with at least 20 observations per series. Interpolated from fixed buckets; confidence is not accuracy.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (backend,type,le) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_bucket[$__range]))) and on (backend,type) (sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_top_confidence_count[$__range])) >= 20)

panels.title: Decision volume by backend and type
panels.description: Cumulative counter increases over selected range by backend/type; logged decisions, not HTTP requests.

panels.title: Top caller abstention share by backend
panels.description: Selected-range fallback-needed share for the top five callers by decision volume; shown only with at least 20 decisions and a nonzero denominator. This is model abstention/deferral, not error or confirmed downstream fallback.

targets.expr: (sum by (backend,caller) (increase(llm_env_jev_fallback_needed_total[$__range])) / on (backend,caller) sum by (backend,caller) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range]))) and on (backend,caller) (sum by (backend,caller) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range])) >= 20) and on (backend,caller) topk(5, sum by (backend,caller) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{outcome="answered"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le,endpoint) (increase(llm_env_laya_duration_ms_bucket{endpoint="/v1/systemone/batch"}[$__range]))) and on(endpoint) (sum by(endpoint) (increase(llm_env_laya_duration_ms_count{endpoint="/v1/systemone/batch"}[$__range])) > 0)

targets.expr: sum by (backend,type) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="typesafe"}[$__range])) / on (backend) group_left() sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="typesafe"}[$__range])) and on (backend) (sum by (backend) (increase(llm_env_jev_decisions_total{backend="typesafe"}[$__range])) > 0)
